close_reason: Defined and tested schema v1 for target names, package layout, private-runtime launcher, internal file digests, runtime data, trust state, external evidence, and future Homebrew inputs. Relocation tests cover spaces and Unicode.
description:
## Outcome

A versioned contract defines the macOS ARM64 archive name, directory layout, launcher behavior, private runtime rules, metadata, checksums, notices, and later target extensions before the builder is implemented.

## Work

1. Define `jido-<version>-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` and its versioned root directory.
2. Define `bin/jido`, `libexec`, private OTP runtime, `LICENSE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`, and `release.json`.
3. Require the launcher to use only the private runtime and preserve arguments, streams, terminal behavior, and exit status.
4. Require the launcher to enter the CLI before application startup.
5. Keep exact help and version requests on the fast path.
6. Require the TUI to paint and accept input before runtime startup. Permit one submitted prompt to wait and run once after ready.
7. Define external outputs for checksum, SBOM, provenance, and acceptance evidence.
8. Define the Homebrew inputs: artifact name, target, version, SHA-256 value, and `bin/jido` location.
9. Define internal file digests and the external archive checksum without recursion.
10. Add schema, archive-layout, and launcher-entry validators.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] macOS ARM64 maps to one target-specific archive and root directory.
- [ ] The contract forbids OTP from `PATH`.
- [ ] Metadata uses the single product version source.
- [ ] The archive is relocatable and supports paths with spaces and Unicode.
- [ ] Help and version can exit before application startup.
- [ ] The first TUI frame can appear before runtime-ready state.
- [ ] A later target can extend the contract without changing current fields.
- [ ] The output has all data needed by a later Homebrew formula except an immutable URL.

## Tests

Add metadata schema, synthetic archive-layout, and launcher-entry tests.

## Non-goals

Do not implement the builder, publish an artifact, or create a Homebrew formula in this task.
title: Define the local artifact and release metadata contract
